exq.q: Excuse me, do you know where the nearest bus stop is?
exq.a: It's just around the corner, next to the post office.
w: I take the bus every morning.
The bus is not very crowded.
exq.why: Hỏi chỗ trạm xe buýt → chỉ vị trí: just around the corner.

exq.q: How far is the hospital from here?
exq.a: About a ten-minute walk. Just follow this road.
exq.why: How far? hỏi khoảng cách → trả lời bằng thời gian đi bộ.

exq.q: Have you seen a black backpack around here?
exq.a: No, sorry. Maybe ask the security guard over there.
w: I bought mine at a night market.
It was too heavy for her.
exq.why: Hỏi có thấy không → trả lời không + gợi ý hỏi bảo vệ.

exq.q: I think I left my phone on the bus. What should I do?
exq.a: Don't panic. Try calling your number first.
w: I don't use my phone much.
exq.why: What should I do? → lời khuyên: đừng hoảng, thử gọi số.

exq.q: Is it safe to walk around here at night?
exq.a: It's fine on the main street, but I'd avoid the dark alleys.
w: The nights are very short now.
Walking is good for your health.
exq.why: Is it safe? → trả lời mức an toàn và chỗ nên tránh.
